title: Autonomous Optimization of Numerical Algorithms by an AI Agent: Application to Atomistic Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13143v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents built on large language models, run in automated improvement loops, can discover more efficient algorithms. We present AIOA, a framework that brings this approach to the numerical algorithms of atomistic simulation: an agent improves an algorithm against a pre-specified metric in a loop guarded by verifiers it cannot alter. Applied to ASE, a widely used atomistic simulation library, AIOA targets two facets of an algorithm: its implementation, rewritten to run faster with unchanged results, and the method itself, redesigned to converge with fewer force evaluations. Agents made six kernels 22-24 times faster on average in Python with NumPy and SciPy. On unseen problems, optimizers from the best configuration needed 3.1-3.4 times fewer force evaluations than L-BFGS for structure relaxation and 4.6-17 times fewer than standard climbing-image nudged elastic band calculations for reaction paths. translated_title: 人工智能体对数值算法的自主优化：在原子模拟中的应用
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型构建的编码智能体在自动化改进循环中运行，能够发现更高效的算法。我们提出了AIOA框架，将这一方法引入原子模拟的数值算法中：智能体在一个由其无法篡改的验证器所守护的循环中，针对预先指定的指标改进算法。将该框架应用于广泛使用的原子模拟库ASE时，AIOA针对算法的两个方面进行优化：一是算法实现，在不改变结果的前提下重写代码使其运行更快；二是算法方法本身，重新设计使其以更少的力评估次数收敛。智能体使六个核心计算模块在Python（结合NumPy和SciPy）环境下平均提速22至24倍。在未见过的测试问题上，最优配置下得到的优化器在结构弛豫任务中所需力评估次数比L-BFGS少3.1至3.4倍，在反应路径计算中比标准爬坡图像弹性带（CI-NEB）方法少4.6至17倍。
tldr: 提出AIOA框架，利用AI智能体在验证器守护的自动化改进循环中自主优化原子模拟的数值算法，实现核心计算模块提速22-24倍，并使结构弛豫和反应路径计算所需的力评估次数减少3-17倍。
en_tdlr: The AIOA framework enables AI agents to autonomously optimize numerical algorithms for atomistic simulation within verifier-guarded improvement loops, achieving 22-24x kernel speedups and requiring 3-17x fewer force evaluations for structure relaxation and reaction path calculations.
